items.problem: Bootstrap omitted legacy csproj Link items outside the supplied source folder, producing an incomplete migration map.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 989-1015 reported 4 copied/mapped files; LanguageFont.csproj lines 93-168 declared linked App, MainPage, scenario XAML, Styles, shared code, and assets.
items.skill_search: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copy logic and searches for Link, ApplicationDefinition, SharedContentDir
items.root_cause: The bootstrap recursively copied the filesystem below -Source but never parsed project items or their Link destinations.
items.proposed_fix: Resolve linked Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content/Resource items, copy them to their Link paths, and include them in mapping/triage.
items.generalizes: Legacy UWP projects commonly share shell code, XAML, and assets through non-SDK csproj Link items in sibling directories.

items.problem: Directly hosted Page skipped required OnNavigatedTo initialization, leaving an alive but empty shell.
items.evidence: MainWindow.xaml directly contained sdk:MainPage; MainPage.xaml.cs populated ScenarioControl only in OnNavigatedTo; migration-score.json failed both features and UIA showed an empty 0x0 ScenarioControl.
items.skill_search: SKILL.md shell conversion table and searches for direct host, OnNavigatedTo, Loaded
items.wrong_text_if_any: | Plain `Frame` (single page) | Single `Page` hosted directly under the `Window` |
items.root_cause: Direct hosting does not perform Frame navigation and therefore never raises OnNavigatedTo.
items.proposed_fix: Correct the shell guidance and add a validator failure for directly hosted Pages that override OnNavigatedTo.
items.generalizes: Many UWP Pages populate controls, restore state, or select initial content in navigation lifecycle overrides.

items.problem: Test-AppLaunch could not discover default dotnet build output.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3641-3649 showed a successful default build under bin\Debug; lines 3661-3663 reported no output under bin\x64\Debug.
items.root_cause: Layout discovery only searched platform-qualified output roots.
items.proposed_fix: Add bin\Debug to target layout candidates.
items.generalizes: Developers frequently run dotnet build without an explicit Platform property before invoking the launch helper.

items.problem: Bootstrap and validator disagreed on the no-deferred-items sentinel.
items.evidence: Bootstrap wrote '| (none) | - |'; validator emitted a consistency warning at session-log.txt line 3673 because it only recognized 'No items deferred'.
items.skill_search: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 deferred output and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 No items deferred check
items.wrong_text_if_any: Validator accepted only the phrase 'No items deferred' while bootstrap emits a '(none)' table row.
items.root_cause: Producer and consumer used different empty-state formats.
items.proposed_fix: Teach the validator to accept the bootstrap's canonical '(none)' row.
items.generalizes: Every migration with zero deferred files otherwise emits this misleading warning.
